bullets.text: EE Expands 5G+ Coverage - **EE** aims to reach over 130 UK cities by end-2025 with its rebranded 5G+ network.
VMO2 Launches Giga Sites - **Virgin Media O2** activates its first Giga Site in London, enhancing 5G connectivity.
Nokia Enhances RAN Automation - **Nokia** absorbs Juniper's RIC assets, boosting AI-driven automation for 5G networks.
AI Integration in 3GPP Release 19 - New AI tools in **3GPP Release 19** aim to enhance network efficiency and performance.
Samsung Partners with Vodafone - **Samsung** to supply vRAN and O-RAN solutions for **Vodafone** across Europe.
Private 5G and AI Convergence - **Private 5G** networks and generative AI are key enablers for Industry 4.0.
Taliban's Telecom Blackout - A nationwide telecom blackout in Afghanistan severely disrupts communication and services.
Connectivity Gaps in Multifamily Properties - Survey reveals significant gaps in telecom strategies for multifamily property owners.
Optus Network Outage - **Optus** customers face another outage, affecting access to emergency services.
Huawei Cloud's AI Compute Service - **Huawei Cloud** announces upgrades to its AI Compute Service, enhancing performance and efficiency.
